cases.note: a clear price edge: BET, flat 1u, BET_NOW
a small edge below the thresholds: LEAN_DIRECTIONAL
no edge at the fair line: PASS_PRICE
a positive edge below 1 point of gap: PASS_INSUFFICIENT_EV
an edge at terrible juice (worse than the price limit): PASS_PRICE
no captured price: PASS_PRICE, never an assumed -110
a stale quote: PASS_MARKET_STALE
books disagree: PASS_MARKET_DISPERSION
an uncertain projection: PASS_MODEL_UNCERTAINTY
submodel disagreement: PASS_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT
an unresolved QB: RESEARCH_QB
one book: RESEARCH_MARKET_IMMATURE
incomplete inputs: RESEARCH_DATA_INCOMPLETE
an extreme edge that passes integrity: RESEARCH_EXTREME_EDGE
an extreme edge with a 2.5-hour-old quote: PASS_DATA_QUALITY
a quote for another game: PASS_DATA_QUALITY
a sign-flipped market: PASS_DATA_QUALITY
after kickoff
the expected model version differs
betting disabled: LEAN NO_BET_BETTING_DISABLED
bet confidence below the policy floor: LEAN_DIRECTIONAL
an assessed consensus that is not actionable: PASS_MARKET_DEGRADED
an assessed consensus that is stale: PASS_MARKET_STALE
a quarantined quote: PASS_MARKET_INVALID
an impossible American price: PASS_MARKET_INVALID
an impossible spread: PASS_MARKET_INVALID
no calibration artifact: NO_BET_CALIBRATION
a model version the artifact was not validated for: NO_BET_VERSION_MISMATCH
a policy without max_price: NO_BET_POLICY
a failed probability computation: NO_BET_COMPUTATION
a projection that is not PREDICTED: NO_BET_COMPUTATION
validated WAIT and a line expected to improve by 2 points: WAIT
a trivial expected improvement: BET_NOW
fractional Kelly validated: 0.25 Kelly, capped at 1u
Kelly input capped at the saturation probability
unvalidated Kelly falls back to flat
a policy asking for full Kelly gets quarter Kelly
the model prefers the away side
a shaded two-sided price (de-vig != 0.5)
a plus-money side
an integer line on 3 (push probability)
a postseason game: schedule week 1 with an explicit early_season 0
a quote carrying the same home team name
just below the thresholds after a BET on the same side: HELD_BY_HYSTERESIS
the same without a buffer: not a BET
a previous BET on the other side is never held
the line moved through the previous bettable-to: PASS_LINE_MOVED
the frozen calibration artifact (flat decision EV curve): the price never clears
the frozen calibration artifact (flat decision EV curve): the price never clears
the frozen calibration artifact (flat decision EV curve): the price never clears
the frozen calibration artifact (flat decision EV curve): the price never clears
the committed production policy with the frozen artifact

correlation_basis.rule: same_game_correlation = 1: every same-game position decision.js creates is a spread and the same side at two books is the same bet (DEV phi of the same team covering at lines 3 points apart: 0.8758)

market_limits.note: at current scale book limits are not the constraint; per-book limits, liquidity and price impact are recorded here when stakes grow (brief §50)

policy.note: Derived by the pre-registered rules of docs/cfb-decision/POLICY_PREREG.md from the DEV walk-forward policy study (docs/cfb-decision/POLICY.md). Betting is disabled: turning it on is a person's promotion decision through the section-86 gate, which this policy fails. Under the frozen calibration artifact the calibrated (curve-mapped) EV is -0.0317 at every price, so no quote clears min_ev and the BET region is empty.
